component.name: Bare
component.summary: A web browser with no title bar: just the page

description.p: Bare is a small web browser built on WebKitGTK. Its window has no title bar and no tab strip: one slim address bar sits above the page, and a sidebar shows the open tabs as a tree, with a tab opened from a link under the tab it came from. F1 hides the sidebar.

It has its own search, derived from SearXNG and built in, so there is no search server to run. It blocks ads and trackers inside the web engine, keeps idle tabs from using memory, and is driven from the keyboard.
Tabs as a tree in a sidebar, a new icon, a much faster start-up and faster history search.
Middle-click and Ctrl+click on a link now open it in a new tab behind the current one; on most links they used to open it in the current tab.
The first start after the upgrade indexes the history in the background, which takes a few seconds for a large one.
